# Vendored dashboard assets

These assets keep the local dashboard usable when external CDNs are blocked or unavailable.

- `bootstrap/bootstrap.bundle.min.js`: Bootstrap 5.3.0, MIT License
- `bootstrap-icons/`: Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3, MIT License
- `fonts/`: IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono, and Source Serif 4 from Google Fonts;
  licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1

Sources:

- https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/releases/tag/v5.3.0
- https://github.com/twbs/icons/releases/tag/v1.11.3
- https://fonts.google.com/
